cancel_confirm.title: Cancel report
cancel_confirm.description: If you cancel, the report will not be saved. You need to complete all steps and submit for the report to be registered.

no_errands: There are no cases to display

search.AUTODETECT: Search by personal identity number or username

save_message.error: Something went wrong while saving the case

about.title: About the case
about.misconduct_alert_description: The case is sent to an independent investigator. Your manager is informed about the case but does not decide the outcome.
about.event_concerns_group_facility_required: Select a location where the deviation occurred when the event concerns a group/the entire operation
about.facility_incomplete: Complete the location selection by choosing a unit – the location controls who can see the case

reporter.title: Reporter
reporter.description: The reporter is the person who initiated the case and our primary contact while the case is being processed. If you are reporting on behalf of another colleague, add that person under other reporter.

user.title: Client
user.description: A client is the individual affected by the case.
user.not_required_title: No client is needed for this case
user.not_required_description: Since the event does not concern an individual client, you do not need to specify a client. You can continue to the next step.

other_reporter.title: Other reporter
other_reporter.description: Specify the colleague you are reporting on behalf of.

other_parties.title: Other parties
other_parties.description: A party can be a contact person, doctor or a relative whose role is important to the case. If you are reporting on behalf of a colleague, you should add that colleague as another party.

stakeholder.reporting_for_colleague: I am reporting on behalf of another colleague

submit_confirm.question: Do you want to submit the case?
